text:
mona (Finance): FYI invoice 2109 (Zephyr Dynamics) shows PAID on bank feed but amount not in our ledger. Bank trace says wire sent to old account ending 4321.
sam (Collections): Ugh. Do we have the remittance? Was it an ACH or SWIFT? We need the trace number to follow up with their bank. @jess can you confirm what AP did?
jess (Sales): AP emailed: they wired via SWIFT at 2168009000 to the account they had on file (legacy contract). They say they're initiating a recall/trace with their bank and will share the SWIFT MT103. Asking us to mark as "in-transit" so we don't start suspension.
mona (Finance): We can't book as received until funds land. However, with a bank letter + MT103 we can apply a provisional/in-transit credit. Legal wants an indemnity if we allow service to continue. Can we get a signed indemnity from the customer?
billing-bot: Created unapplied transaction UAP-2109 at 2168009999.
sam (Collections): My recommendation: grant a 15-day grace, apply provisional credit pending trace + bank letter, require indemnity and card or PO on file. If not resolved in 15 days escalate to legal. Approve?
ravi (Finance Manager): Approve provisional holding and 15-day in-transit grace if they upload the MT103 and a bank letter. Require written indemnity that authorizes recollection or offsets if funds don't arrive. Add reminder at 21 days to review.
jess (Sales): Customer uploaded MT103 and a bank confirmation PDF a few minutes ago and emailed a signed indemnity template. Pasting the confirmation: "Zephyr AP confirms wire sent to legacy account on 2168009000; recall in progress."
mona (Finance): Docs received and attached to billing case. billing-bot, attach docs to invoice 2109 and flag as "provisional-credit".
billing-bot: Documents attached to invoice 2109. Provisional credit of $65,000 applied as IN-TRANSIT. Reminder set for follow-up at 2168022000.
sam (Collections): Updated collections board: "Zephyr Dynamics - in-transit provision; 15-day grace." If provisional credit reverses, we auto-open suspension flow and notify AM + legal.
ravi (Finance Manager): Manager sign-off logged. If funds are not received by 2168022000, escalate to legal and reinstate suspension notice.
jess (Sales): Customer acknowledged the terms and confirmed indemnity signed. They'll notify once recall completes. I'll keep CS in the loop to avoid surprise interruptions.
mona (Finance): Good. Closing thread for now; will reopen if payment doesn't clear. Thanks everyone.
